customManagers.description: The pinned Biome schema URL in biome.json. Renovate's npm manager bumps the `@biomejs/biome` devDependency but has no idea this URL encodes the same version, so a plain bump leaves the schema one version behind — biome then validates the config against the wrong schema and the drift is silent. Same class of split as homelab's tag/digest managers: two places holding one version, only one of which any built-in manager can see.

packageRules.description: Biome moves biome.json and can churn test snapshots; keep it in its own PR rather than batched with unrelated bumps.
